title: Possession transplanted onto another manifest -> POSSESSION_INVALID

source.model: S-P3 Q4 companion B (possession not tied to manifest)

scenario: A service-key signature over some other document is presented as possession.kms for the accepted manifest. L0 form (E10R-05): the same receipt's S_kms, which signs F_kms, not F_manifest.

mutations.with: the same receipt's S_kms bytes (from a_sig)

needs: One real receipt; copy S_kms out of a_sig into possession.kms (post-issue edit; no signing, no TEST key).

subcases.title: L0 form: the receipt's own S_kms as the possession proof
subcases.construction: A-a; post-issue: possession.kms := the same receipt's S_kms (a service-key signature over F_kms, not over F_manifest). Post-issue edit only; no TEST signing (E10R-05)
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*): the edit leaves a_sig and receipt_anchor untouched, so rows 11.1-11.4 still pass; U from the same headers

subcases.title: TEST form: POS-a
subcases.construction: conformance POS-a construction: possession.kms over the TEST bytes 'TEST not the manifest'
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
